# convoy_event_replay (Action)

Replays an event: Convoy re-dispatches it to every endpoint it was originally sent to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# terraform apply -invoke=action.convoy_event_replay.incident_1234 -var event_id=...
action "convoy_event_replay" "incident_1234" {
  config {
    event_id = var.event_id
  }
}

variable "event_id" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_id` (String) Event to replay.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
